editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: Tickmill is a legitimate FCA-regulated ECN broker scoring 7.6/10 from NAFT in 2026. Its Raw account at 0.0 pips + $6 round-turn commission is the cheapest ECN pricing available under Tier-1 regulation. Limited to approximately 200 instruments and MT4/MT5 only — but for pure forex traders focused on minimising execution cost, Tickmill is hard to beat on value.
